_comment: Databricks Jobs API definition for the config-driven ingestion pipeline.
Or via the Databricks UI: Workflows → Create Job → Import JSON.
BEFORE IMPORTING — update the following placeholders:
Task 1 — source_lookup: connects to source, runs COUNT queries per table
(threaded), filters out 0-row tables, inserts SKIPPED audit rows, and
publishes approved config IDs via dbutils.jobs.taskValues.
Task 2 — run_source_ingestion: reads taskValues, skips 0-row tables,
and runs main ingestion (same as before). Falls back to all active tasks
name: generic_source_to_bronze_ingestion

parameters.name: config_master_id
parameters.description: Config Master ID pointing to the child config table (e.g. 13 for NoSQL, 2 for RDBMS).

parameters.name: source_system_id
parameters.description: Source System PK (integer) from config_source_system table.

parameters.name: target_catalog
parameters.description: The Databricks target catalog (e.g., main or hive_metastore).

parameters.name: pipeline_name
parameters.description: Pipeline name — must match pipeline_lookup_config.pipeline_name for lookup query resolution.

parameters.name: job_run_id
parameters.description: Databricks job run ID — auto-populated from job context.

parameters.name: landing_volume_path
parameters.description: Base S3/Volume path for raw landing (e.g. s3://pfl-raw/landing). Leave blank to skip.

parameters.name: max_workers
parameters.description: Max parallel workers for both lookup and ingestion ThreadPoolExecutors.

_comment: Task 1: source_lookup — runs COUNT queries for all active ingestion tables.
Tables with 0 rows get a SKIPPED audit record and are excluded from Task 2.
Approved config IDs are passed to Task 2 via dbutils.jobs.taskValues.
Depends on source_lookup; reads taskValues to get the filtered config ID list.
Falls back to all active tasks if run standalone (outside a job).
